acceptance_scope: P58F8 A1 visual acceptance of retained browser artifacts, not strict A0 original-game parity.
visual_findings: Authentic faction tactical bitmap cockpits, ship portraits, meters, starfields, planets, ship markers, command controls, target displays, and status surfaces are visible.
Both viewports preserve the complete cockpit without visible stretching or clipping.
Faction portraits, planetary imagery, and meter colors remain distinct and readable.
limitations: The accepted review inspected retained browser captures rather than operating movement controls.
The movement contract is independently asserted by the deterministic harness, not by the static visual review.
